issues.description: The template initializes number_of_bits_classical_register as a string ("0") which is a type mismatch with the solution (an integer 4) and with the problem requirement to create a ClassicalRegister with an integer number of bits. This will cause errors when students try to construct ClassicalRegister(self.number_of_bits_classical_register) or otherwise use the value as an integer.
issues.suggestedFix: Change self.number_of_bits_classical_register in the template from the string "0" to an integer (e.g. 0 or the intended default such as 4). Ensure the template uses an int so ClassicalRegister() can be constructed without type errors. For example: self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 4 (or 0 as a placeholder integer).
